name: apple-l10n-toolkit
description: Three-direction localization audit and translate workflow for Apple app projects (.strings / .xcstrings).

interface.shortDescription: Audit and complete localization for Apple app projects.
interface.longDescription: Check locale completeness, detect hardcoded UI strings missing from catalogs, find unused catalog keys, and translate missing entries across locales through a repeatable l10n/ workflow.
defaultPrompt: Find hardcoded UI strings missing from my string catalog.
Find unused keys in my .xcstrings catalog.
